name: Hinata Masaya
source:
"I love the sky."

Those words involve the life of Masaya time ago, but now he doesn't fly anymore, until he meets the right person at the right time, or maybe a group. Obstinate about himself, but how about that group? Maybe... he can make them love the sky, but he doesn't know why.
